product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides energy-efficient AI chips and software that help developers build and deploy physical-AI applications on edge devices.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its physical-AI hardware and software platform, while the Developer Center establishes the developer audience and application-building purpose. Sources: https://sima.ai/ and https://developer.sima.ai/

pricing_page.notes: The public Edgematic page has a Pricing section listing Free, Premium and Business plans. Plans qualify even where purchasing requires contacting the company. Source: https://sima.ai/edgematic

named_customers.notes: The closest reviewed list combines customers and partners without distinguishing their status. At least two customer-only names could not be established, so partner names were excluded and the list is empty. Source: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones/

employee_band.notes: The reported employee count is 245 as of September 30, 2026, which falls within 201–500. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/simaai/__hrXbyBEFp-A08KOSB51lFFOxWAS7MJbrkfK_TATmjMo

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly describes its headquarters as being in San Jose. Source: https://sima.ai/our-story | hq_country: The company identifies San Jose as its headquarters, and its company profile places that address in California, US. Sources: https://sima.ai/our-story and https://linkedin.com/company/sima-ai

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2018. Source: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-secures-funds-and-readies-new-generative-edge-ai-platform

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying technical posts were identified: the Modalix engineering deep dive by VP Hardware Engineering Srivi Dhruvanarayan, and the LLiMa compiler/framework article by Associate VP, MLA Software Ashok Sudarsanam. They discuss hardware subsystems and compiler architecture, respectively. Sources: https://sima.ai/blog/an-engineering-deep-dive-on-sima-ai-mlsoc-modalix and https://sima.ai/blog/llima-sima-ais-automated-code-generation-framework-for-llms-and-vlms-for-10w/

public_docs.notes: The public Developer Center provides hardware, software, model and example documentation sections, rather than a lone FAQ. Source: https://developer.sima.ai/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification (AI2517), a qualifying title. The direct posting rendered only a careers shell, so the live board listing is the stronger evidence. Sources: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai?fr=false&nl=1 and https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai/job/oHtmAfwQ

model_provider.notes: The release announcement names Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4 running on Modalix, adds Whisper large-v3-turbo to LLiMa, and identifies Supertonic 3 as GenAI Studio’s default text-to-speech engine. OpenAI-compatible APIs alone were not treated as evidence of using OpenAI. Source: https://community.sima.ai/t/palette-neat-v0-5-0-release/2036

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed privacy policy contains no named claim of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS certification or compliance. The empty list reflects that page, not proof that the company has no certifications. Source: https://sima.ai/privacy-policy

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company explicitly calls the September 2026 financing Series C. Source: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones/ | funding_date: The latest round is dated September 28, 2026, yielding 2026-09. The funding history also identifies this as the latest round. Sources: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones/ and https://tracxn.com | funding_amount_usd: The latest announcement explicitly reports $150 million in Series C financing; $500 million is cumulative funding, not the round amount. Source: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones/

raised_18mo.notes: The $150 million Series C announced September 28, 2026 falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. Source: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones/

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable open-position inventory lists engineering, accounting and manufacturing roles, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive title. Source: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai?fr=false&nl=1

launched_6mo.notes: Palette Neat 0.5.0 was released October 6, 2026, inside the May 9–November 9 window. It added substantive capabilities, including ready-to-run detection, segmentation and anomaly-detection applications, rather than only fixes or UI changes. Source: https://community.sima.ai/t/palette-neat-v0-5-0-release/2036

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: the compact management page was reviewed, but it supplies no joining dates. No dated announcement established a qualifying join or departure during November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; the listing alone cannot establish the timing. Source: https://sima.ai/our-story

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable careers inventory and developer entry page name no CRM or sales-and-marketing system. The empty list means no qualifying visible signal was found in those materials, not that the company uses none. Sources: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai?fr=false&nl=1 and https://developer.sima.ai/
